amount: Savings toward purchase of a new building for our Alliance location - negotiations started in 2025

answer: 2025 was our first full year of having our own pharmacies. Given the unknowns, the salaries of $387K for pharmacists and the $130K for our clinical pharmacists were sustained using H80 Grant funds. We had additional $8K in audit/consulting work done, which was not billed until 2026. This year we are transitioning the full costs of our pharmacy to the 340B program. We anticipate that the surplus funds will be used to remodel the building we purchased in early 2026 and to finance the mortgage on the building. We are increasing our foot print in Alliance, OH and hope to offer expanded services with the addition of dentistry, a very needed service in this community. We have already expanded our clinical pharmacy program in 2026 and have also hired an Engagement Pharmacist to improve our capture rate and the communication between our patients and pharmacy services & staff.
